review_description: All the SolarQuotes Boxes ticked plus more!On Site Assessment prior to Quote.All Q's answered + extra Information offered that I had not been aware of.Post-Quote/Proposal meeting (before signing anything) to go over some more questions.Installation Date set by agreement and adhered to.Very smooth & professional installation (complex configuration including two seperate roofs & a significant Meter Box upgrade).No mess.Post Installation follow-up with new Q's answered including a post-insertion of smart meter query.Overall: Their reliablity & honesty of communication and actions throughout the whole installation & follow-up process were outstanding.
